Visit note | 2025-05-31 11:00 AM | Dr. Rumana Haque, Endocrinology | Patient: Abdul Karim, 61, male. Mr. Karim returns for review, stating he has been passing urine often and losing weight without trying. He is a cricket coach and notes his symptoms were found during a routine test before a trip to Noakhali. He reports taking his prescribed routine consistently and has experienced no dizziness or blurred vision. On examination: fasting glucose 8.6 mmol/L, BP 111/78 mmHg, pulse 87 bpm, weight 76 kg. His extremities show normal sensation and brisk reflexes. Assessment: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Plan: chronic follow-up; continue current medicines, no new prescription issued today. He was advised to reduce rice portions and sweets, walk briskly 30 minutes five days a week, check fasting sugar twice weekly, and check the feet daily. Follow-up in 3 months with HbA1c.
